name: PRC Nursing (PNLE)
notes: PRC lists five Nursing Practice subjects with 100 items each. It does not state separate subject weights, so equal weights are assumed.
PRC's two test-framework documents describe the content of each Nursing Practice differently and do not show an effective date. Check the latest PRC resolution for which topics each one covers.
RA 9173 as printed on the PRC site shows the passing average as '785%'; this is read as 75%.
